dogecoin.text:
Here's the first article on The Express. If you read this quickly, it sounds like Jeff Bezos *has* backed Dogecoin, and it therefore may go to $1. (read it twice and you realise, Jeff has done nothing).

Ie, a similar hype idea to the one believed by the man who lost his savings. https://t.co/AXSwbNir6f

The entirety of the Daily Express's "City & Business" page is taken over by content pumping Dogecoin & Safemoon.

As the note on the right here shows (via @davecraige), there are real-world ramifications of hyping things like this to the general public. https://t.co/ofvJAdTwZG

It looks like the Express have now flipped their entire "City & Business" section to articles about Dogecoin/Safemoon/Bitcoin.

(Nb: this probably looks like a parody, but is the actual page - ht @MatthewScholes) https://t.co/W6AjN8XHPM
